question: In a certain code language, 'COMPUTER' is written as 'RETUCOMP' and 'LAPTOP' is written as 'POTLAP'. How will 'BOTTLE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9774d380fef452901e6571892e5c3e7828b95985718cafbb9cdcf713867b3832.png] 

LOGIC:

1) Word is divided into half. 

2) First half of the word becomes the second half of the word.

3) Letters of the second half of the word are reversed to make the first half of the new word. 

Option 1:

 'COMPUTER' is written as 'RETUCOMP'
